summary: Built the file-kind breakdown. Core has a fixed internal extension table (FileKinds: ten kinds, a span lookup that ignores case) and KindBreakdown.Compute, a single pass over a returned store. It adds each kind's files, ChargedSize and ChargedOnDisk, keeps each kind's top 3 extensions plus a remainder, builds no string per file, and caps unmapped extensions at 65,536, a figure sized from a measurement of the C: drive. The window computes the breakdown once at each Completed or Cancelled ending, holds it in MainWindow.Kinds, and clears it when a scan starts and at Could not read / Scan failed endings. The breakdown is shown as a 'File kinds' view of the results cell: a choice on the cell's header line swaps it with the folder tree. The schema-1 --report gains an additive 'kinds' array ({id,label,files,size,onDisk}) and layout keys for the view. All 19 new Core tests, the full Core suite (259) and all 37 non-network window cases pass, including 3 new ones (K-001..K-003). On the real C: drive the shipped exe's kinds add up to the root's core figures to the byte, and with the view chosen all 10 rows are in view.

files.why: Public FileKind enum (10 kinds), plus an internal extension-to-kind FrozenDictionary (OrdinalIgnoreCase) read through a ReadOnlySpan<char> alternate lookup, and the stable ids and labels. The map is the spike's, with aax/aa/m4b added to audio, ts removed, msp/msu/avif added, and the programs label 'Programs & system files'.

Result records (KindBreakdownResult, KindTotal, ExtensionTotal, ExtensionRemainder) and Compute(ScanStore): one pass over File entries using Path.GetExtension on the name span and a seeded Dictionary<string,int> alternate lookup. Unmapped extensions up to UnmappedExtensionCap=65,536 each get their own slot; past that they share one overflow slot that is never listed. The pass then folds into kinds with top 3 extensions and a remainder, sorted by on-disk, then size, then kind.

Pure words for the kinds rows (no WPF), linked into Core.Tests like StoppingWait.cs: share of the on-disk total ('—' when that total is 0), the extensions cell ('.mp4 40.1 GB · … · + N more, X' or '+ more than N others, X'; '—' for No extension), and the Installers/Programs tooltip.

The TopLevelPanel header line now holds a 'Folders | File kinds' RadioButton choice, which adds no height. The existing headings, results list and tree are wrapped in FoldersView, and a new KindsView sits beside it: a one-line caption, column headings, and a ListBox with Kind | Files | Size | On disk | Share | Biggest extensions.

Adds the single holder Kinds. ShowKinds runs Compute once in ShowOutcome after ShowFolderTree and fills the caption and rows. AwaitKinds runs at StartScan: it clears the holder and shows 'Shown when the scan finishes.'. HideKinds runs in ShowProblem, for Could not read and Scan failed. OnResultsViewChanged swaps the two views.

Adds an additive 'kinds' array ({id,label,files,size,onDisk}, with no extensions or names), omitted while MainWindow.Kinds is null. Adds window keys ShowKindsButton, KindsView, KindsCaption and KindsList. Schema doc updated; the schema stays 1.

19 tests, some of them theory rows, covering the C-001..C-012 and C-014 shapes: classification, a reconcile on a real NTFS tree (hardlink, junction, directory and file symlinks, compressed, sparse, a 359-character path, an unreadable folder), a cancelled scan, cloud-only, empty stores, the overflow past the cap, and allocation.
Links src/FsAnalyser.App/KindRowText.cs as source, the way StoppingWait.cs is linked.

New cases. K-001: seven kinds against the tree in order, sums against core, the view chosen at the default size (all rows in view) and at the minimum size with 26 drive buttons (at least one full row), and a tree with no file. K-002: Stop, with the kinds' sums equal to core's partial totals. K-003: rescan, with no kinds at the second scan's start or at its Could not read ending. B-001's missing root and C-012's throw case now also assert that no kinds are left.

New 'kinds' mode, modelled on expand: after the first ending it sets ShowKindsButton.IsChecked as a click would, so a report shows the kinds view on screen. It accepts FSA_HOOK_MINSIZE and FSA_HOOK_DRIVES.

The SL-046 settled rules were already appended by the engine (the pre-existing modification). This build adds src/FsAnalyser.Core/Analysis/KindBreakdown.cs to the except_files of SL-044's 'Core does not publish a live ScanStore before the scan ends', because Compute takes a returned store, as LargestFiles.cs already does.

obligations.how: Owed to validate-slice, not to this stage. The evidence is ready. FileKinds.Of is total: empty maps to NoExtension, anything unmapped to Other, and overflow folds into Other. AssertAddsUp runs in every KindBreakdownTests fact and checks that the kind sums equal FilesBelow(0), RolledSize(0) and RolledOnDisk(0). On the real C: drive, the shipped exe's kinds summed exactly to core: 3,616,381 files, 1,056,100,344,208 B, 764,074,657,896 B on disk.

Owed to validate-slice. Evidence: Compute is called only in ShowOutcome, which runs after Scanner.Scan has returned (MainWindow.xaml.cs StartScan awaits the scan first). The store reaches the App only as ScanResult.Store. Compute also passes on a Cancelled store (AStoppedScanAddsUpToWhatItRead, K-002). The Debug.Assert was dropped, per the M2 disposition.

KindBreakdownTests.MixedCaseAndMultiPartNamesClassifyByTheirLastExtension feeds MOVIE.MP4, Holiday.Mkv, a.tar.gz, Backup.TAR.GZ, IMG_0001.JPEG, Book.AAX and Level3.PAK. Each goes through FileKinds.Of and through a store beside its lower-case twin: one kind, one extension, written in lower case.

KindBreakdownTests.ANameWithNoExtensionOrATrailingDotIsTheNoExtensionRow feeds noext, trailingdot., Makefile and archive.tar. Each lands in the no-extension row, with no listed extension and the extensions cell '—'.
KindBreakdownTests.ADotfileIsOtherUnderItsWholeNameNotNoExtension: .gitignore (twice, in two cases) and .editorconfig land in Other as '.gitignore' and '.editorconfig', not in no-extension.

KindBreakdownTests.ASetupProgramIsAProgramAndOnlyPackagesAreInstallers: Hermes-Setup.exe, setup.exe and audacity-...exe go to Programs; .msi, .msix and .msu go to Installers; both rows carry the setup-program tooltip.

KindBreakdownTests.AddsUpToTheRootOnARealTreeUnderEveryCountingRule: a 3 MiB mp4 with a second hardlink name. Videos holds 3 files and 3 MiB + 1000 B (the bytes counted once), and the totals equal the root.

Same test: a junction, a directory symlink and a file symlink (link.zip) point at an outside folder and outside.zip. All three are Link entries, Archives holds only a.tar.gz, and the totals equal the root. Neither link kind is skipped (Q-001).

Same test: notes.txt (4 MiB, compact /c) and disk.iso (sparse, 1 GiB, 64 KiB written). Documents is 4 MiB in size and at most half that on disk; Disk images is 1 GiB with 64 KiB..1 MiB on disk and ranks below Videos.

KindBreakdownTests.FilesWithNothingOnDiskAreListedAndTheirShareIsADash: a synthetic cloud-only store (size > 0, on disk 0). Three rows are listed, ordered by size, every share is '—', and KindRowText.Share(0,0) is '—'.

KindBreakdownTests.AStoreWithNoFilesHasNoKindsAndZeroTotals: a root-only store, a store of folders and a link, and a real scan of empty folders all give empty Kinds, zero totals and no rows. Window case K-001 shows 'No files.' with an empty kinds array.

KindBreakdownTests.ExtensionsPastTheCapAreNeverListedButAlwaysCounted: 65,536 distinct unmapped extensions, a repeat of the first one, a 1 GiB extension past the cap, 50 more past the cap, then clip.MP4. The totals reconcile, the .mp4 is Videos, the past-cap extension is never listed, and the remainder holds it with MoreUncounted.

KindBreakdownTests.APassBuildsNoStringPerFile: 200,000 files over 50 extensions in three cases each; one pass allocated 32,928 B against a 256 KiB limit. Mutation check: switching to ToString().ToLowerInvariant() per file allocated 23,431,304 B and failed the test, and the source was then restored.

Core: KindBreakdownTests.AStoppedScanAddsUpToWhatItRead cancels after 3 folders; the status is Cancelled, 6 of 30 files are read, and the kinds equal the partial root totals. Window: K-002 presses Stop; the kinds sum to core's partial files/bytes/bytesOnDisk, with the caption 'in the part read before the scan stopped'.

Window case K-003 uses FSA_HOOK_MODE=rescan. At the second scan's start the report has no 'kinds', KindsList has 0 rows and the caption reads 'Shown when the scan finishes.'. At the second scan's Could not read ending (FSA_HOOK_MISSING) there are also no kinds.

Measured the C: drive with the real scanner: 3,642,885 files, 3,021 distinct extensions, 2,958 of them unmapped, and none first seen past 4,096 (0 B). The cap was raised to 65,536, 22x what was seen, about 7 MiB worst case. A row whose listed extensions do not cover it now shows a remainder ('+ N more, X' or '+ more than N others, X'). The overflow Fact checks that a past-cap extension larger than every listed one appears in the remainder.

Added KindBreakdownTests.AStoppedScanAddsUpToWhatItRead (cancel after N folders through ScanOptions.AfterFolder). Its kind sums equal FilesBelow(0), RolledSize(0) and RolledOnDisk(0) of the partial store and Totals; Scans.AssertChargedBytesAreTheTotals passes on that store.

A faulted scan computes no kinds: ShowProblem, used for Scan failed and Could not read, calls HideKinds, which nulls the holder and clears the rows, so the report omits 'kinds'. C-012 (throw) now plants a stale report that carries kinds and asserts it is gone; B-001's missing root and K-003's missing shape assert no kinds. ShowKinds runs after ShowFolderTree, with no swallowing catch. The scanner-throws ending cannot be driven by any hook mode; it shares ShowProblem with Could not read.

(a) No extension has empty TopExtensions and an empty Remainder, and its cell shows '—' (tested). A dotfile shows under Other as its whole lower-cased name, '.gitignore' (tested). (b) Confirmed that schema-1 'core' carries files, bytes and bytesOnDisk. K-001 and K-002 compare the kinds sums with them, and they match.

cases.test_name: tests/window/WindowCases.ps1 K-003 (Test-K003: rescan mode, kinds absent at the second scan's start and at its Could not read ending)

deviations: Where the panel sits. The design says 'a small ListView following the LargestFilesPanel pattern' and does not say where it goes. I built it first inside the outcome panel. After a completed scan at the default size, the outcome is held at its minimum (276 px) and the tree needs at least 240 px for 12 rows (T-case). Measured: the texts row took 128 of its 173 px, the largest-files list dropped to its 56 px minimum, and window case B-001 failed ('LargestFilesList built all three rows'). The table is now a 'File kinds' view of the results cell, chosen by a RadioButton on the cell's existing header line. That adds no height anywhere, and all 37 window cases pass. Cost: the table is one click away rather than on screen by default. The report carries 'kinds' either way. On the real C: drive with the view chosen, all 10 rows are in view. The design's placeholder 'Shown when the scan finishes' is what the view shows during a scan.

Added a 'kinds' mode to tests/window/FsaWindowHook (StartupHook.cs), modelled on 'expand', so a window case can show the kinds view on screen at the default and minimum sizes. The design named no hook change; that note concerned M4's rescan assertions, which use the existing rescan mode unchanged.
UnmappedExtensionCap is 65,536, not 4,096. This is the accepted M3 fix, sized from the C: measurement: 2,958 distinct unmapped extensions.

The design's 'Name span accessor (only if Name(i) allocates)' was not needed: ScanStore.Name(i) already returns ReadOnlySpan<char> over the pooled name page (ScanStore.cs:80). No accessor and no layout change.
No Debug.Assert on a completion flag, per the M2 disposition: the store has no such flag, and the guard is structural.
not_built: Plant rows in eng/rules-harness/plants.json for the two SL-046 settled rules. The design's coherence note said they 'may need one plant per rule'. Recording their outcomes needs the TAAD engine (harness.py), which this build did not run. Existing plant anchors in MainWindow.xaml, MainWindow.xaml.cs and LargestFiles.cs still exist.

An end-to-end window case for the 'Scan failed' ending, where Scanner.Scan throws. No hook mode can make the scanner throw. The code path is ShowProblem to HideKinds, which it shares with Could not read, and that is exercised by B-001 and K-003.
follow_ups: Layout: after a completed scan the outcome panel stays at its minimum (about 276-292 px) at every window height up to about 1,300 px, because the tree takes 3*. The kinds table therefore had to become a view choice. A splitter, or tabs for folders, kinds and largest files, would let a person see more than one at a time.

Rules-harness plant rows for the SL-046 settled rules ('the breakdown reads the finished scan store and never the filesystem', 'only Core classifies files into kinds'), recorded through harness.py with the TAAD engine.
Existing StartupHook.AfterList catch logs 'refused mode=rescan' for exceptions in any mode (expand, and now kinds). It should log the actual mode.

Evidence for the person's open questions on the design: on this PC's C: drive, measured through the shipped exe, Other is 22.97% of on-disk bytes (175.5 of 764.1 GB) and No extension is 17.7%. The largest unmapped extensions are .db, .lib and .incomplete (2.6%, 2.4%, 2.2%). Installers (package formats only) is 1.5%; Programs & system files is 26.8%.

The design questions the person has not answered are still open: installers limited to package formats, dropping ts from Videos, a no-extension row of its own, Programs and system files as one row, top 3 extensions inline, where the table lives.

tests.note: 19/19. The real-tree reconcile gave 9 files, 1,081,148,992 B, 3,805,792 B on disk, equal to the root. The allocation Fact measured 32,928 B per pass.

tests.command: pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File eng/dotnet.ps1 test tests/FsAnalyser.Core.Tests/FsAnalyser.Core.Tests.csproj -nologo --filter "FullyQualifiedName~FsAnalyser.Core.Tests.KindBreakdownTests.APassBuildsNoStringPerFile" (with KindBreakdown.cs temporarily mutated to store.Name(i).ToString().ToLowerInvariant())
tests.note: Mutation check, failing as intended: 23,431,304 B per pass, and the test failed. The source was restored and confirmed with grep.
259/259 Core tests: 240 baseline plus 19 new, including ArchitectureRulesTests and RuleCopiesAgreeTests. The SynchronousIoCancelTests flake from build-check did not recur.

Run during development with the first placement, the table inside the outcome's texts. It failed 'LargestFilesList built all three rows' because the list was squeezed to 56 px. That caused the move to a view choice; B-001 passes in the final All run.

All 37 cases passed: C-001..C-014, O-016, L-001..L-003, B-001..B-008, V-001, P-001, T-001..T-006, K-001..K-003. N-001..N-004 were NOT RUN (opt-in -IncludeNetwork, they change SMB mappings). The tree viewport at the default size is 284 px, above the 240 px limit.

Final run inside All. Seven kinds in the expected order, with sums equal to core. With the view chosen at the default size, all 7 rows are built and in view (268 px). At 560x620 with 26 extra drive buttons, 1 full row is in view.

tests.command: scratch console in %TEMP%/sl046-m3 (ProjectReference to src/FsAnalyser.Core), run as Measure.exe on the C: drive
tests.note: M3 measurement with the real Scanner.Scan: Completed in 84 s; 3,642,885 files; 3,021 distinct extensions, 2,958 unmapped; 0 extensions past 4,096. KindBreakdown.Compute took a median of 118 ms and allocated 1.35 MB per pass over 4.5M entries. The kinds reconciled exactly with FilesBelow, RolledSize and RolledOnDisk of the root.

Real use: the shipped single-file exe (published at 20:26 from the final sources) on the C: drive exited 0, status Completed. The kinds array has 10 kinds and sums to core exactly: 3,616,381 files, 1,056,100,344,208 B, 764,074,657,896 B on disk. The caption reads '36,16,381 files scanned, sorted by extension. Files in 674 unreadable folders are not included.' The Folders view is the default; KindsList holds 10 rows.
The hook chose the kinds view after the C: ending. The report shows KindsView visible, KindsList inView with 10 of 10 rows realized and all 10 fully in view in 268 px, and FolderTree not visible.
